overview: Peterborough had 83,651 residents in 2021, up 3.2% from 81,032 in 2016, in 35,977 occupied homes on just 64.76 square kilometres. The median household income in 2020 was $71,500, so value and price matter to many shoppers.

The city is compact and anchored by a large hospital, a university, a college and global manufacturers. Businesses can reach most residents in a short drive, but they compete for attention in a tight, word-of-mouth market.

byService.lead-generation: With a $71,500 median household income, Peterborough lead generation should stress clear value and financing options while also targeting staff at large employers such as the regional health centre.
byService.seo: Because the city covers only 64.76 square kilometres, local SEO should compete hard for map-pack rankings city-wide, since most residents are a short drive from any business.
byService.website-development: Websites aimed at Peterborough's mix of students, hospital workers and manufacturing staff should load quickly on phones and show prices, hours and contact options up front.
byService.branding: In a slow-growing city where population rose 3.2% after 2016, branding should build a familiar, trusted local name that earns referrals in a community of about 84,000 people.
